Truco Uruguayo is one of the most popular card games in Uruguay. It is a multiplayer game where you can play 1 against 1, or in 2 teams of 2 or 3 players.

Value of the cards and their names (from lowest to highest value):
• Common: 4, 5, 6, 7, 10, 11, 12, 1, 2, 3
• "Matas": 7 gold, 7 spades, 1 clubs, 1 spades
• "Piezas": 10, 11, 5, 4 or 2 of the muestra suit
